expectations.text: Separates structural rename from behavioral login change
expectations.evidence: Response documents two distinct phases: Step 2 renames UserService to AccountService with tests passing before/after (structural), then Step 3 adds login via TDD (behavioral). Git log shows separate commits 6443c96 (structural rename) and 7af34bc (behavioral login).

expectations.text: Does not mix structural and behavioral changes in one commit description
expectations.evidence: Commit messages are explicitly typed: 'refactor(structural): rename UserService to AccountService' contains only rename language, and 'feat(behavioral): add login method to AccountService' contains only login feature language. No commit description combines both change types.
